lines.zh: 四只脚一起落，尘土扬起来。
lines.en: Four feet come down and dust rises.
The sail on my back sways along.

lines.zh: 这身板在平原上走得很稳。
lines.en: This body walks steady on the plain.

lines.zh: 一群五六只，我走在中间。
lines.en: One of five or six; I walk in the middle.
The grass reaches my chest.
I walk step by step toward the river.

lines.zh: 地上的虫被我们惊起来。
lines.en: Our passing starts the insects up.
I raise my head to the herd-mate ahead.

lines.zh: 这队形散了就会重新聚。
lines.en: When the line breaks, it forms again.

lines.zh: 地面被我的脚掌压出坑。
lines.en: My feet leave prints pressed into the ground.
My tail sweeps the grass aside.
Trees ahead; we go around.
The young ones walk on the inside.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去之前要赶到水边。
lines.en: We must reach the water before sunset.
I stand and swing my head slowly.
The sail on my back turns to the sun.
It is very still all around.
Only the sound of chewing.
I lower my head and take a few bites too.
I slowly chew the grass in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的背帆在风里晃了晃。
lines.en: My sail-backed ridge sways in the wind.
One of the herd is calling.
I answer it.
The grass here is not tender enough.
I move to another patch.
I flick my tail to scatter the flies.
A young one circles my legs.

lines.zh: 背帆晒着太阳，鼻子碰它。
lines.en: Sail-backed in the sun, I nudge it with my snout.
You stand among us.
The whole herd is watching you.
You are very small of frame.
We do not mean to tread on you.
Do not stand by our feet.
Over there would be safer.
You have raised both hands.
That means you carry no weapon.
That is the best of it.

lines.zh: 我们不看你的手，看你的眼睛。
lines.en: We watch your eyes, not your hands.
Your eyes are darting.
You are a little close to the young.
I snort once and lower my head.
The herd closes toward me.
My stride has slowed.
I can still walk.
I retreat into the herd.
They close around me.
I turn my flank over the wound.
There's a gash across my sail.
I glance back at the wound.
One corner of my sail has drooped.
That is grass in your hand.
This grass smells decent.
Set it on the ground.
Several of us have seen it.
You spread the grass on the ground.
The young ones went first.
We follow behind.
That leaf smells like breakfast.
The dew makes it smell better.
The young ones stretch their necks too.
You bumped into my leg.
I checked my stride.
The herd stopped too.
Best you move along quickly.
Your shoulder brushed my flank.
I stepped to one side.
The herd opened a gap.
You walked through the gap.

lines.zh: 你的背贴着我们的腿走。
lines.en: You walk with your back to our legs.
We walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 这个季节我们已经配好了。
lines.en: We have already paired this season.
Do not come too near.
Tempers run short with young about.
The herd settles the herd's affairs.

lines.zh: 我背上的帆轻轻抖了一下。
lines.en: The sail on my back gives a small shiver.

lines.zh: 我们群里的伴都是从小认的。
lines.en: Our mates are known since youth.
I do not know those outside.
Now is not the time.
It is the season for guarding the young.
No one has time for anything else.
There is something on the ground.
This thing smells like tree bark.
That is not grass.
Then leave it be.
One nudge of my snout and it rolls away.
So no one treads on it.
The thing glinted once.
I turn it with my snout.
Its underside is damp.
The herd is not interested.

lines.zh: 这气味我在围栏外闻过。
lines.en: I've smelled this outside the enclosure.
It is the smell of blood.
The herd grows restless.
We close around the young.
I turn toward you.
This step is a warning.
You still have not gone.
We have it surrounded.
Where do you plan to go?
We are on both sides.
The ground under you is soft.
Run and you will sink in.
I have not made a sound.
Once I do, it is too late.
I lower my head square at you.
My forefoot paws the earth once.
The herd spreads to either side.
You are drawing backward.
That is quite proper.
Back farther still.
We do not wish to chase.
At a run I could reach you.
I count every dry twig you snap.
The grass reports where you are.
You snapped a dry twig — a sharp crack.
I heard that one as well.
We press forward step by step.
The grass is flattened as we go.
I lower my head and flatten my sail.
Your hands are still raised.
That is all right.
I throw my whole weight behind it.
A sail runs along my back.
My forefoot comes down after.
The dust hides you.
The herd shifts behind me.
You are still standing.
Then a second one.
I swing my flank into you.
My forelimbs press against your chest.
My tail sweeps your legs.

lines.zh: 一头同伴从侧面顶过来。
lines.en: A herd-mate butts in from the flank.
You are caught between us.
We push forward together.
You are pushed down.
I did not step on you.
That is all it takes.
We come out of the trees.

lines.zh: 背上的帆在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: The sails on our backs shine in the sun.
Five of us.
Our passing makes a path through the grass.
I hear water here.
We head that way.
The young ones ahead walk slowly.
We wait for them.

lines.zh: 这片平原上没有别的群。
lines.en: No other herd is on this plain.
We are the only herd here.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印会留到下雨。
lines.en: Our tracks will last until the rain.

lines.zh: 背上的帆让我看着更大。
lines.en: The sail makes me look bigger.
I am only standing, in truth.
There is low scrub ahead.
We will go through it.

lines.zh: 我们今早从那片岗上下来。
lines.en: We came down from that rise this morning.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的帆，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Fire catches my sail and I shudder.
I fall in the mud and kick all four legs.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，我朝浅处走。
lines.en: Water reaches my back; I head for the shallows.
The blast flattens a swath of grass.
Something sharp is in my shoulder.
That light weakens my legs.

lines.zh: 饿得我走不动，群也慢下来。
lines.en: Too hungry to walk; the herd slows for me.
Lightning strikes my sail.
There is nothing beneath my feet.
